learned_patterns.pattern: The signal engine ran fine but its TRIGGER failed silently: scheduled runs stopped after 2026-06-30 and no manual fire replaced them, leaving the matrix stale for 9 days and forcing SAFE MODE every session. A single manual workflow_dispatch refreshed it instantly. Monitor the trigger, not just the engine — a healthy engine with no trigger is the same as a broken one.

v1.4 embeds compressed_summary inside signal_matrix.json and stopped writing the standalone signal_summary.txt. A 'success' run therefore left the documented §2.5 lean read path stale. A green workflow status does not guarantee the file a consumer actually reads was updated — verify the specific artifact, not just run conclusion.

NET showed a 4/5 gate on the 06-30 matrix but is Z=2.16 OVERBOUGHT on fresh 07-09 data after a +12% run — the stale gate pointed straight at a local top. Never authorize an entry on a stale matrix; the whole point of SAFE MODE is that a 9-day-old gate is worse than no gate.

INTC breached its ATR stop and was sold at -15% on 2026-07-07 while the signal engine was dark. The between-session fractional stop layer is independent of the signal engine and held — downside protection survived the outage even though new-entry logic was frozen.

Dividend streak/growth fields healed this run (SCHD 14y/50.6%, VYM 15y, VIG 12y, DGRO 9y). The §15.3 dividend-growth screen (streak>=5) is finally verifiable for the growth ETFs; payout_ratio remains null but streak+yield+safety now suffice to qualify SCHD/DGRO/VYM.
